title: Foxtons reports 6% revenue fall as rental reforms impact lettings
summary:
Foxtons has reported a 6% decline in third-quarter revenue to £45.9m as the Renters' Rights Act disrupted its lettings business. The London-listed estate agency group saw lettings revenue fall 7% to £31.1m, whilst sales revenue declined 5% to £12m.

title: Student housing portfolio secures £4.1m refinance deal
summary:
A portfolio of 11 student houses across Coventry and Cardiff has been refinanced with a £4.1m facility from Secure Trust Bank Business Finance. The five-year deal covers 80 bedrooms generating approximately £540,000 in annual rental income.

title: Foxtons reports £2.7m revenue hit from Renters’ Rights Act
summary:
London estate agency Foxtons has reported a £2.3 million decline in third quarter revenue, attributing £2.7 million of the impact to tenant-led early terminations following the introduction of the Renters' Rights Act on 1 May 2026. The agency's Q3 trading update showed total revenue fell 7% to £31.1 million compared to the same period last year.

title: Block management firm Supa secures £21m seed funding
summary:
Property technology company Supa has raised £21 million in seed funding as it expands its operations in the UK block management sector through a series of acquisitions. The company, founded in 2025, has acquired seven managing agent firms and now oversees 20,000 properties.

title: UK rental growth holds at 5% as void periods lengthen
summary:
Annual rental growth in the UK remained at 5% in October 2026, though monthly increases slowed from 0.9% in September to 0.6%, according to data from lettings platform Goodlord. Average void periods between tenancies increased to 28 days in October, up from 20 days in September.

title: AI property search platform launches for London buyers
summary:
A former estate agent has launched an AI-powered property search tool targeting London's residential market, positioning the service as an alternative to traditional buying agencies. Oskar uses artificial intelligence to match buyers with properties including off-market listings from participating estate agents.

title: Newton Fallowell Peterborough sold to sole director
summary:
Newton Fallowell Peterborough has changed ownership after existing director Kieran Arthur completed the purchase of the business from co-founder Jason Treadwell. Arthur co-founded the office with Treadwell in April 2022 and has been central to its operations since launch.

title: UK property agents lag on AI adoption for compliance
summary:
Two-thirds of senior compliance professionals in UK estate agencies are exploring artificial intelligence for client due diligence processes, but implementation remains limited. Only 6% have embedded AI into their operations despite 85% reporting increased compliance demands over the past year.

title: Estate agents face digital marketing shift in 2027
summary:
Estate agencies face significant changes to digital marketing strategies as AI-driven search, first-party data collection and brand trust emerge as key factors for 2027. The shift away from traditional search engines and reliance on property portals could reshape how agents compete for clients.

title: Property completion delayed by frozen digital bank account
summary:
A homebuyer in Oxfordshire faced potential completion delays after digital bank Revolut froze access to a £37,000 house deposit during a "routine security review". The account holder's wife had her account suspended for nearly three weeks, restricting access to funds needed for property completion.
